_readme: Industrial canteen. Source deck exports are NOT committed (public repo).
Most views are unmarked. The directors' dining view carries a framed logo panel on
the back wall, patched by sampling the same wall panel above it. One servery view
(p19) is excluded in favour of p18, which shows the same fixed-bench dining

canteen-exterior.alt: Industrial canteen building in brick with a metal roof and a glazed entrance
canteen-exterior.caption: The canteen as its own building: brick, metal roof, glazed entrance. Indicative viewpoint.

exterior-side.alt: Side elevation of a canteen building with a brick wing and a rendered service block
exterior-side.caption: The service block sits behind, with its own access for deliveries and gas. Indicative viewpoint.

ground-floor-plan.alt: Annotated canteen floor plan marking dining halls, kitchen, wash areas and toilets
ground-floor-plan.caption: The whole building on one plan: 200-seat workers' dining, 120-seat staff dining, 16-seat directors' dining, kitchen, wash lines and toilets.

workers-dining.alt: Workers' dining hall with fixed bench tables and stools under a metal roof
workers-dining.caption: Workers' dining, 24150 x 9255 mm for 200: fixed tables and stools, nothing to move or lose. Indicative viewpoint.

staff-dining-rows.alt: Staff dining hall with rows of loose tables and chairs beside a vending machine
staff-dining-rows.caption: Staff dining, 11961 x 12015 mm for 120: loose furniture, so the room can be re-set. Indicative viewpoint.

staff-dining-tables.alt: Dining hall with clerestory glazing above a brick dado and a drinks chiller
staff-dining-tables.caption: Clerestory glazing above the brick dado lights the hall without west glare at the tables. Indicative viewpoint.

cafe-counter.alt: Cafe counter with high stools, pendant lights and a round table beyond
cafe-counter.caption: The cafe counter: a short break taken standing, away from the dining halls. Indicative viewpoint.

serving-counter.alt: Serving counter in timber and stone with a slatted screen dividing the seating beyond
serving-counter.caption: Serving counter, with a slatted screen separating it from the quieter seating. Indicative viewpoint.

directors-dining.note: CLIENT MARK: framed logo panel, centred on the back wall
directors-dining.alt: Directors' dining room with a round table, slatted timber screens and panelled walls
directors-dining.caption: Directors' dining, 11900 x 5000 mm for 16, screened rather than walled off. Indicative viewpoint.
